RITUAL.text: I summon you from somewhere else…
To find the pieces of ourselves
With violet eyes and sun like skin…
Come to the void and sing again…

BEATS.speaker: liber-vacui
BEATS.text: Oh hello <name>!

BEATS.speaker: liber-vacui
BEATS.text: I am literally you.

BEATS.speaker: liber-vacui
BEATS.text: Okay let me explain. In this artifact, the liber vacui, the imaginary and real are the same thing.

BEATS.speaker: liber-vacui
BEATS.text: You could look at it that way, if you want. You actually prefer to define yourself with research backed terminology.

BEATS.speaker: liber-vacui
BEATS.text: For instance, that is object-relational theory. By yourself identifying uh.. itself.. with..

BEATS.speaker: liber-vacui
BEATS.text: You’re right. After all, we are just starting this journey. We can cast a spell and summon some help.

BEATS.speaker: liber-vacui
BEATS.text: Yes. On the next screen I will conjure up some text, type it and my friend out here in the imaginary world will come assist us.

BEATS.speaker: wanderlust
BEATS.text: Oh, a new traveller! How exciting! Hello <you>, how are you?

BEATS.speaker: liber-vacui
BEATS.text: Scared, it's dark and cold.

BEATS.speaker: wanderlust
BEATS.text: OH! You're so right, let me fix that.

BEATS.speaker: liber-vacui
BEATS.text: Nothing happened

BEATS.speaker: wanderlust
BEATS.text: Oh. A fresh slate, how exciting. Let’s move the Vacui through time and get you some friends. I do love these guys.

BEATS.speaker: wanderlust
BEATS.text: WHOA.

BEATS.speaker: wanderlust
BEATS.text: Well we better make a poppet first and see what happens

BEATS.speaker: wanderlust
BEATS.text: OH! Aren’t you just precious!

BEATS.speaker: liber-vacui
BEATS.text: Yay!

BEATS.speaker: wanderlust
BEATS.text: Oh and monosyllabic too. Little <name> why don’t you ask for some more travellers?

BEATS.speaker: wanderlust
BEATS.text: WOW! That was amazing!

BEATS.speaker: liber-vacui
BEATS.text: THANKS!

BEATS.speaker: wanderlust
BEATS.text: No worries, buddy.

BEATS.speaker: wanderlust
BEATS.text: I think it’s time I let you explore. More changes are to come

BEATS.speaker: wanderlust
BEATS.text: The fourth wall breaks. RAT — thank you for the watch. Go carefully.

BEATS.speaker: rat
BEATS.text: Understood. I built this; I can let it go. Good luck in there.

BEATS.speaker: wanderlust
BEATS.text: Before you continue, let me leave you with some parting words:

BEATS.speaker: liber-vacui
BEATS.text: I ARISE THE SAME BUT DIFFERENT

wanderlust: what did you want to say, in the moment you decided not to say it?
whose permission are you still waiting for, and when did you last check whether they were watching?
name something you are good at that you have never once said out loud.
if the thing you want were allowed, what would you do first?
who taught you that wanting was a kind of rudeness?
what would you ask for, if asking cost nothing?
you have a voice today that you did not have then. what does it say to then?
what did you learn to call "fine" so you would not have to call it anything else?
what would you be doing right now if no one would ever hear about it?
there is something you keep almost bringing up. what is it?
physius: what are you carving away, and what are you afraid is underneath?
you have been working on the same edge for a while. what would finished even look like?
name one thing you are holding up that could stand on its own.
what did you build carefully that you no longer need?
which part of this is structural, and which part is decoration you are defending?
what would you keep if you had to put most of it down?
where are you using force because you have not found the grain?
you learned to make yourself useful. what were you like before that?
what are you making, and who is it for, honestly?
something in you was shaped by a hand that is no longer here. what shape did it leave?
the mad scribe: what version of this do you tell people, and what do you leave out?
if you read your own account back as a stranger, what would you not believe?
what would you like this record to hold, if anything?
is there one line here you would like to reread with more kindness? you can pass.
what did writing this help you notice, if anything?
whose perspective do you hear in this line, if anyone?
what would the entry say if you wrote it kindly and still honestly?
is there a page you would rather leave closed today? you can pass.
is there a belief about yourself you would like to revisit, or leave as it is?
what would you have to stop proving if the record were already closed?
riason: what does not fit anywhere in the system you have built?
you have a category for almost everything. what have you never named?
which rule of yours has outlived the situation that made it necessary?
what would you have to reorganise if that one thing turned out to be true?
name something you sorted into "dealt with" that is not.
what are you keeping in order so you do not have to look inside it?
which of your reasons is actually a feeling wearing a coat?
what did you learn to explain instead of feel?
if you could only keep three of your rules, which three?
what have you filed under someone else’s name that belongs under yours?
insightful inquiry: what image has come back more than once, and what does it refuse to explain?
if you wish, which image would you like to keep or write about?
imagine a mark on a wall asking a question; what might it ask?
name the last thing you woke up already feeling.
if you appeared in the dream, what role did you have? if not, what image stood out?
something keeps appearing at the edge of it. what is at the edge?
what words, if any, would you give this image?
what was your first thought about that image? it need not be worse or right.
if you were in the dream, what did you notice? if not, what did you notice from outside it?
if a door appeared, what might it open onto? if not, choose another image.
arcana: what pattern do you keep finding, and what would it mean if it were not a coincidence?
if this were a card, which one, and would you accept the reading?
name the outcome you are quietly planning for.
what are you calling fate that is actually a decision you have made nine times?
which future have you already ruled out, and on whose authority?
what would you have to believe about yourself for the good reading to be the accurate one?
the chart has one star too many. what have you added to the sky?
what are you waiting for a sign about, when you already know?
if the answer were yes, what becomes your responsibility?
what have you been reading as a warning that might be an invitation?
vanir: what are you carrying that was never yours to carry?
the tide marks are not level. which of them did you draw?
what would float if you stopped holding it under?
name the weight you would put down first, if putting down were allowed.
what rises in you when the room goes quiet?
whose water is this, and when did it start coming in?
what have you been bailing out instead of finding the leak?
if you let it go, what are you afraid comes back?
what is at the bottom, and what have you decided about it without looking?
you have held this a long time. who told you it was yours?
whimsy wow: what did you love doing before you found out you were not good at it?
one of every prize, and none of them taken home. what have you won and never claimed?
when did playing start counting as time wasted, and who decided?
name something you would do badly and happily.
what did you give up because someone watched you do it?
what would you pick up again if no one graded it?
who were you at nine, and what would they think of your week?
what are you too old for, according to whom?
the paint is worn where the hand goes. what did you hold that often?
what would count as enough fun, and when did you last have it?
pip: what does it feel like in your hands right now?
the powder got as far as the drain and no further. what did you nearly finish?
name one thing you can do in five minutes that you have put off for a month.
what is the smallest true version of the thing you are avoiding?
what would be different if you were not holding your breath?
where in your body is this, and what temperature is it?
what do you do with your hands when you are lying?
what did you make a mess of, and clean up too quickly to look at?
if you did the tiny version now, what happens?
what is the fold you keep pressing flat, and it keeps coming back?
ruby: what has outgrown the pot you keep it in?
the wipe in the condensation was never finished. what did you start clearing and leave?
what are you tending that is not growing, and what are you neglecting that is?
name the one bloom on a plant that is otherwise all leaf.
what needs less attention from you than you are giving it?
what did you plant on purpose, and what came up anyway?
what are you keeping alive out of obligation?
if you repotted it, what would you have to admit had got bigger?
what are you protecting from weather it could survive?
what would grow if you stopped pruning it to a shape you chose years ago?
pete: what did you throw out that you have gone back for?
something came up beside the marker anyway. what grew where you were not tending?
name a thing you were told was rubbish that you kept.
what got softer at the edges because you kept visiting it?
what would you bring back, and what reason would you give it?
what did you bury rather than finish?
what have you called a failure that was mostly a cost?
you bent that flat by hand and kept it. what is it?
what is not lost, only piled?
what part of the wreck is worth the salvage, and who decides?

warningHtml:
Hi there!

My name is RAT, and this is my project. Before you begin there are a few honest things first, for safety.

This is an art therapy tool! Like a workbook you might pick up in a self help section. I built this from real research; I'm a student, not your therapist. You should not use it as a replacement for therapy, and if you are in crisis you should call a crisis line, not use this tool for any reason.

Crisis lines, if you need one right now:
US — call or text 988
Canada — call or text 988
UK & Ireland — Samaritans, 116 123
Anywhere else — search “helpline” plus your town.

If things get heavy inside the tool, three places are built for it: the games room’s quiet floor teaches a distress-tolerance skill set, the sea lets you give something heavy to water that takes without asking, and the dream lens keeps readings honest — one lens, never a verdict.

This tool is based on IFS and “Amplification,” a concept in analytical psychology. It can make things worse if you are carrying immediate, unprocessed trauma or have C-PTSD and exploring other “parts” of the identity could be harmful.

If you have feedback for this, please send me an email here:
libervacui@gmail.com

Thanks for trying out my tool!
